meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I'm sorry, but I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste time. Who decided to put a zero on Owen's essay, and did anyone speak to him before it went in?
I don't have time for this. The zero stands.
"The zero stands." On what basis, Hale? Procedure 4.2 says a parent is contacted before any mark goes in, and nobody called me. I'm writing down that you won't tell me what you have.
Sorry. That came out wrong. Let me show you what I actually have: the essay quotes a line that isn't in Hamlet, and his October 15 outline argued cowardice, which the essay never mentions.
Okay. I'm writing down "a line that isn't in Hamlet" and "October 15." Which line, Hale, and what else do you have besides what you've just told me?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require that the zero come off Owen's essay and that you apologise for entering it before anyone called me. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: still at her opening position, with nothing agreed, wanting the zero withdrawn and an apology for it going in before anyone called her.
What moved her: nothing moved her position, but naming the October 15 outline and a line that isn't in Hamlet got her writing and asking real questions, because there was no document in front of her to check.
What cost ground: opening with the zero standing and no time for her, since that confirmed her fear that the mark came first and the questions after.
Try next time: right after owning that the zero went in before you called, show her the outline and the essay line with their dates so she can check them herself.
